original: Bless the LORD , ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
proposed: Bless the LORD , ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

original: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD .
proposed: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD .

original: Praise ye the LORD . O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
proposed: Praise ye the LORD . O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

original: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD .
proposed: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD .

original: Praise ye the LORD . Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD , that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
proposed: Praise ye the LORD . Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD , that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

original: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD .
proposed: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD .

original: Gracious is the LORD , and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
proposed: Gracious is the LORD , and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

original: O praise the LORD , all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
proposed: O praise the LORD , all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

original: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD .
proposed: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD .

original: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
proposed: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

original: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD : we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD .
proposed: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD : we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD .

original: God is the LORD , which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
proposed: God is the LORD , which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

original: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
proposed: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved, [Name]: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

original: Blessed be the LORD , who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
proposed: Blessed be the LORD , who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

original: Our help is in the name of the LORD , who made heaven and earth.
proposed: Our help is in the name of the LORD , who made heaven and earth.

original: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD .
proposed: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD .

original: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD .
proposed: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD .

original: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
proposed: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:

original: Praise ye the LORD : for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
proposed: Praise ye the LORD : for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.

original: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
proposed: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:

original: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD .
proposed: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD .

original: Praise ye the LORD . Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights. . Praise: Heb. Hallelujah, etc
proposed: Praise ye the LORD . Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights. . Praise: Heb. Hallelujah, etc

original: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
proposed: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

original: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
proposed: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

original: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD .
proposed: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD .

original: Praise ye the LORD . Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
proposed: Praise ye the LORD . Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

original: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD .
proposed: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD .

original: Praise ye the LORD . Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
proposed: Praise ye the LORD . Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

original: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD . Praise ye the LORD .
proposed: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD . Praise ye the LORD .

original: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
proposed: My son, [Name], hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

original: My son, keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
proposed: My son, [Name], keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

original: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
proposed: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge, [Name].

original: Commit thy works unto the LORD , and thy thoughts shall be established.
proposed: Commit thy works unto the LORD, [Name] , and thy thoughts shall be established.

original: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
proposed: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end, [Name].

original: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
proposed: Cease, my son, [Name], to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

original: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
proposed: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty, [Name]; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

original: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
proposed: My son, [Name], give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

original: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.
proposed: Prepare thy work without, [Name], and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.

original: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
proposed: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, [Name]; and thy want as an armed man.

original: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
proposed: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself, [Name]; and discover not a secret to another:

original: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.
proposed: Hast thou found honey, [Name]? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.

original: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour’s house; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.
proposed: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour’s house, [Name]; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.

original: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward thee.
proposed: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, [Name], and the LORD shall reward thee.

original: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
proposed: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit, [Name]? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

original: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
proposed: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words, [Name]? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

original: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.
proposed: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.

original: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.
proposed: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.

original: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:
proposed: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:

original: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
proposed: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

original: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
proposed: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.

original: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
proposed: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.

original: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
proposed: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

original: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
proposed: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

original: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
proposed: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

original: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
proposed: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.

original: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
proposed: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

original: And not only so , but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
proposed: And not only so , but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.

original: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
proposed: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

original: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
proposed: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:

original: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
proposed: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.

original: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
proposed: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

original: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
proposed: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.

original: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
proposed: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.

original: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
proposed: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.

original: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
proposed: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

original: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
proposed: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.

original: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
proposed: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.

original: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
proposed: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

original: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
proposed: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

original: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
proposed: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

original: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
proposed: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

original: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
proposed: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

original: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
proposed: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

original: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
proposed: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

original: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
proposed: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

original: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
proposed: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

original: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
proposed: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

original: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
proposed: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

original: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
proposed: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.

original: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
proposed: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.

original: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
proposed: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

original: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
proposed: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.

original: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
proposed: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.

original: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him , and comfort him , lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
proposed: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him , and comfort him , lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.

original: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
proposed: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

original: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
proposed: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;

original: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
proposed: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.

original: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
proposed: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:

original: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
proposed: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

original: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
proposed: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

original: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
proposed: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.

original: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
proposed: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.

original: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
proposed: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

original: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
proposed: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

original: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
proposed: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

original: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
proposed: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

original: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
proposed: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

original: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
proposed: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;

original: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
proposed: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.

original: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.
proposed: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.

original: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
proposed: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

original: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
proposed: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:

original: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
proposed: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.

original: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
proposed: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;

original: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
proposed: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:

original: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
proposed: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.

original: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.
proposed: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.

original: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is , of other men’s labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
proposed: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is , of other men’s labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,

original: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
proposed: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

original: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
proposed: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.

original: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
proposed: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

original: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
proposed: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

original: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
proposed: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

original: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
proposed: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

original: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
proposed: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

original: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
proposed: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

original: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
proposed: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

original: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
proposed: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

original: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
proposed: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

original: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men , especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
proposed: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men , especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

original: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
proposed: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

original: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
proposed: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

original: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
proposed: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

original: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
proposed: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:

original: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
proposed: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

original: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
proposed: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

original: In whom ye also trusted , after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
proposed: In whom ye also trusted , after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,

original: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
proposed: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

original: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
proposed: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

original: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
proposed: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,

original: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
proposed: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

original: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
proposed: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

original: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us ;
proposed: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us ;

original: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
proposed: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.

original: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
proposed: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

original: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
proposed: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

original: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
proposed: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

original: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
proposed: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.

original: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
proposed: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;

original: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
proposed: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

original: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
proposed: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

original: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
proposed: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

original: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.
proposed: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

original: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
proposed: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

original: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
proposed: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

original: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
proposed: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

original: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
proposed: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

original: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
proposed: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.

original: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
proposed: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

original: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
proposed: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

original: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
proposed: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

original: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
proposed: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

original: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
proposed: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

original: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
proposed: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;

original: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it , and knew the grace of God in truth:
proposed: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it , and knew the grace of God in truth:

original: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
proposed: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.

original: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
proposed: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:

original: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
proposed: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

original: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
proposed: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

original: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
proposed: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

original: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
proposed: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

original: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
proposed: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

original: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
proposed: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

original: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
proposed: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

original: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
proposed: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

original: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
proposed: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

original: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
proposed: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

original: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
proposed: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

original: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
proposed: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

original: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
proposed: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.

original: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
proposed: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

original: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,
proposed: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,

original: For ye are our glory and joy.
proposed: For ye are our glory and joy.

original: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
proposed: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

original: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
proposed: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:

original: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
proposed: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;

original: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men , even as we do toward you:
proposed: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men , even as we do toward you:

original: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.
proposed: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.

original: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
proposed: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

original: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
proposed: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

original: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
proposed: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

original: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
proposed: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

original: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men .
proposed: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men .

original: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
proposed: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

original: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
proposed: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

original: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
proposed: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

original: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
proposed: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

original: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
proposed: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:

original: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
proposed: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

original: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
proposed: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:

original: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
proposed: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

original: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
proposed: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

original: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
proposed: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

original: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
proposed: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.

original: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
proposed: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

original: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
proposed: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

original: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
proposed: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

original: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
proposed: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.

original: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it .
proposed: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it .

original: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
proposed: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

original: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
proposed: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

original: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
proposed: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

original: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
proposed: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:

original: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
proposed: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

original: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
proposed: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;

original: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did ; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
proposed: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did ; by the which we draw nigh unto God.

original: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us .
proposed: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us .

original: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
proposed: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

original: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
proposed: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:

original: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
proposed: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

original: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
proposed: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.

original: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
proposed: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

original: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
proposed: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.

original: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
proposed: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

original: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
proposed: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.

original: Grace be with you all. Amen.
proposed: Grace be with you all. Amen.

original: Knowing this , that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
proposed: Knowing this , that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

original: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
proposed: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.

original: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
proposed: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.

original: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
proposed: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.

original: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
proposed: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:

original: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
proposed: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

original: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
proposed: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

original: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
proposed: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:

original: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
proposed: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

original: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
proposed: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:

original: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
proposed: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

original: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
proposed: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:

original: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
proposed: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

original: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
proposed: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:

original: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
proposed: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

original: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
proposed: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

original: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
proposed: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.

original: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you .
proposed: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you .

original: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
proposed: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

original: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
proposed: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,

original: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
proposed: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

original: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
proposed: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;

original: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
proposed: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

original: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
proposed: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

original: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
proposed: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:

original: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
proposed: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.

original: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;
proposed: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

original: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
proposed: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

original: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
proposed: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;

original: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it , and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
proposed: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it , and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

original: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
proposed: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

original: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
proposed: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

original: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
proposed: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

original: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
proposed: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.

original: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
proposed: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

original: Hereby perceive we the love of God , because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
proposed: Hereby perceive we the love of God , because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

original: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
proposed: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

original: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
proposed: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

original: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
proposed: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.

original: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
proposed: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

original: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
proposed: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

original: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
proposed: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

original: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
proposed: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

original: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
proposed: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.

original: We love him, because he first loved us.
proposed: We love him, because he first loved us.

original: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
proposed: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.

original: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
proposed: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.

original: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

original: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
proposed: To teach you truth, [Name], reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?

original: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
proposed: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, [Name], of those who are collateral for debts.

original: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
proposed: If you don’t have means to pay, [Name], why should he take away your bed from under you?

original: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.
proposed: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up, [Name].

original: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
proposed: Do you see a man skilled in his work, [Name]? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.

original: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;
proposed: When you sit to eat with a ruler, [Name], consider diligently what is before you;

original: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.
proposed: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite, [Name].

original: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
proposed: Don’t weary yourself to be rich, [Name]. In your wisdom, show restraint.

original: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
proposed: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not, [Name]? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

original: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.
proposed: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words, [Name].

original: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
proposed: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words, [Name].

original: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
proposed: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you, [Name].

original: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
proposed: Apply your heart to instruction, [Name], and your ears to the words of knowledge.

original: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.
proposed: My son, [Name], if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

original: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
proposed: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right, [Name].

original: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
proposed: Listen, my son, [Name], and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!

original: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!
proposed: Let your father and your mother be glad, [Name]! Let her who bore you rejoice!

original: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
proposed: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, [Name], or as he who lies on top of the rigging:

original: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.
proposed: for by wise guidance you wage your war, [Name], and victory is in many advisors.

original: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.
proposed: If you falter in the time of trouble, [Name], your strength is small.

original: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;
proposed: My son, [Name], eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;

original: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.
proposed: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul, [Name]. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.

original: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,
proposed: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls, [Name]. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,

original: My son, fear the LORD and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,
proposed: My son, [Name], fear the LORD and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,

original: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.
proposed: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring, [Name].

original: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.
proposed: Let another man praise you, [Name], and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.

original: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.
proposed: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend, [Name]. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.

original: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.
proposed: Be wise, my son, [Name], and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.

original: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,
proposed: Know well the state of your flocks, [Name], and pay attention to your herds,

original: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.
proposed: The lambs are for your clothing, [Name], and the goats are the price of a field.

original: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
proposed: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, [Name], for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
